rows.text_en: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency ( AIDS Control Division ), 043-719-7332

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「후천성면역결핍증 예방법」 및 동법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2005. 9. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Prevention of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended Sep. 28, 2005>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(의사 또는 의료기관 등의 신고) ① 「후천성면역결핍증 예방법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제5조제1항에 따라 감염인을 진단하거나 감염인의 사체를 검안한 의사 또는 의료기관은 진단 또는 검안한 때부터 24시간 이내에 다음 각 호의 사항을 별지 제1호서식(전자문서를 포함한다)에 따라 보건소장에게 신고해야 한다. <개정 2019. 9. 27., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Reporting by Physicians or Medical Institutions, etc.) ① A physician or medical institution that diagnoses a person infected or examines the corpse of a person infected pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the “Act on the Prevention of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall report the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the Head of the Public Health Center within 24 hours from the time of diagnosis or examination, in accordance with Form No. 1 (including electronic documents). <Amended Sep. 27, 2019; Dec. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 감염인에 대한 진단방법, 주요 증상 및 주요 감염경로
rows.text_en: 1. Diagnostic methods, major symptoms, and major routes of infection for infected individuals
2. Date of diagnosis and initial consultation for the infected person
3. Inspection Number

rows.source_ko: 4. 감염인의 사망 및 검안연월일과 검안 내용(사체를 검안한 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Date of death and autopsy of the infected person and details of the autopsy (limited to cases where the corpse was examined)

rows.source_ko: 5. 진단한 의사의 성명과 그가 종사하는 의료기관의 주소 및 명칭
rows.text_en: 5. Name of the diagnosing physician and the address and name of the medical institution where he/she works

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제5조제2항에 따라 학술연구 또는 혈액 및 혈액제제에 대한 검사에 의하여 감염인을 발견한 자나 해당 연구 또는 검사를 실시한 기관의 장은 발견한 때부터 24시간 이내에 다음 각 호의 사항을 별지 제1호의2서식(전자문서를 포함한다)에 따라 질병관리청장에게 신고해야 한다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2019. 12. 31., 2020. 9. 11., 2024. 5. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Act, any person who discovers an infected person through academic research or testing of blood and blood products, or the head of the institution that conducted such research or testing, shall report the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency within 24 hours of discovery, using Form No. 1-2 (including electronic documents). <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Dec. 31, 2019; Sep. 11, 2020; May 30, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 연구 또는 검사의 방법 및 연구 또는 검사연월일
rows.text_en: 1. Method of study or test and date of study or test

rows.source_ko: 2. 연구 또는 검사자의 성명과 그가 종사하는 기관의 주소 및 명칭
rows.text_en: 2. Name of the researcher or examiner and the address and name of the institution where they work
3. Matters concerning infected persons

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제5조제3항에 따라 감염인이 사망한 경우 이를 처리한 의사 또는 의료기관은 처리한 때부터 24시간 이내에 다음 각 호의 사항을 별지 제1호서식(전자문서를 포함한다)에 따라 관할 보건소장에게 신고해야 한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ In the event that an infected person dies pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 3 of the Act, the physician or medical institution that handled the case shall report the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the head of the competent public health center within 24 hours from the time of handling, in accordance with Form No. 1 (including electronic documents). <Amended Dec. 31, 2019>
1. Name, Resident Registration Number, and Address of the Deceased
2. Date of death and major symptoms prior to death

rows.source_ko: 3. 사망 전 감염인을 진단한 의료기관의 명칭 및 소재지와 진단한 의사의 성명
rows.text_en: 3. Name and address of the medical institution that diagnosed the infected person prior to death, and the name of the diagnosing physician
④ Deleted <December 31, 2019>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 5, 2008]
Article 3 Deleted <September 5, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(보건소장 등의 보고) 법 제5조제4항에 따른 보고는 별지 제1호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Reporting by the Head of the Public Health Center, etc.) The report pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.
[Wholly Amended Sep. 5, 2008]
Article 5 Deleted <September 5, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(검진통지) ①「후천성면역결핍증 예방법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제12조제1항에 따른 수시검진대상자에의 검진통지는 별지 제2호서식에 의한다. <개정 2008. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Notice of Examination) ① The notice of examination to persons subject to periodic examination pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Prevention of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form. <Amended Sep. 5, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의하여 지정된 검진일시에 검진을 받지 아니한 자에 대한 검진 독촉통지는 별지 제3호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: ② The notice urging examination for persons who have not received an examination at the designated examination date and time pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ③수시검진대상자로서 귀국하는 자에 대하여는 제1항의 규정에 불구하고 입국시 구두 또는 인쇄물등의 방법으로 검진통지에 갈음할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ Notwithstanding the provisions of Paragraph 1, for persons returning as subjects for periodic examinations, notification of examination may be substituted by oral or printed means, etc., upon entry.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(검진절차 및 신고 등) ① 법 제8조에 따른 검진을 목적으로 혈액검사를 실시하는 기관(이하 “검사기관”이라 한다)은 별지 제4호서식의 후천성면역결핍증 검사대장 또는 별지 제5호서식의 후천성면역결핍증 익명검사대장 및 검사결과(전자문서를 포함한다)를 작성ㆍ보관하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Examination Procedures and Reporting, etc.) ① An institution conducting blood tests for the purpose of examination pursuant to Article 8 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Testing Institution”) shall prepare and keep the Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome Test Register in Form No. 4 of the Attached Form or the Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome Anonymous Test Register in Form No. 5 of the Attached Form, and test results (including electronic documents). <Amended Sep. 5, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ②검사기관은 검사 결과 감염이 의심되는 검사물을 발견한 때에는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자(이하 “확인검사기관의 장”이라 한다)에게 검사를 의뢰하여 확인검사를 받아야 한다. <개정 2003. 12. 27., 2005. 9. 28., 2008. 3. 3., 2010. 3. 19., 2019. 9. 27., 2020. 9. 11., 2025. 4. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② When an inspection agency discovers a specimen suspected of infection as a result of an inspection, it shall request an inspection from any of the persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as the “Head of the Confirmatory Inspection Agency”) and undergo a confirmatory inspection. <Amended Dec. 27, 2003; Sep. 28, 2005; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Sep. 27, 2019; Sep. 11, 2020; Apr. 1, 2025>
1. Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
2. The head of the Institute of Public Health and Environment pursuant to Article 2 of the Institute of Public Health and Environment Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「의료법」 제3조에 따른 의료기관 중 진단검사의학과 전문의가 상근(常勤)하는 의료기관의 장
rows.text_en: 3. The head of a medical institution among those under Article 3 of the Medical Service Act where a specialist in diagnostic laboratory medicine is employed full-time

rows.source_ko: 4. 「고등교육법」 제4조에 따라 설립된 의과대학 중 진단검사의학과가 개설된 의과대학의 장
rows.text_en: 4. The head of a medical college established under Article 4 of the Higher Education Act that has a Department of Diagnostic Laboratory Medicine
5. Head of a confirmation testing institution designated and notified by the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제8조제4항에 따라 익명검진을 실시한 자는 검진결과 감염인으로 밝혀진 자가 있는 경우 밝혀진 때부터 24시간 이내에 다음 각 호의 사항을 별지 제5호의2서식(전자문서를 포함한다)에 따라 보건소장에게 신고해야 한다. 이 경우 감염인의 정보는 익명으로 관리해야 한다. <신설 2008. 9. 5., 2019. 9. 27., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ A person who has conducted anonymous screening pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall, if a person is identified as infected as a result of the screening, report the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the Director of the Public Health Center within 24 hours from the time of identification, using Form No. 5-2 (including electronic documents). In this case, the information of the infected person must be managed anonymously. <Newly added Sep. 5, 2008; Sep. 27, 2019; Dec. 31, 2019>
1. Gender of the infected person
2. Date of Confirmation Diagnosis
3. Inspection Number

rows.source_ko: 4. 검진의사의 성명과 검진기관의 주소 및 명칭
rows.text_en: 4. Name of the examining physician and address and name of the examination institution

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따라 신고를 받은 보건소장은 별지 제5호의2서식에 따라 특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장에게 이를 보고하여야 하고, 보고를 받은 특별자치도지사는 질병관리청장에게, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 특별시장ㆍ광역시장 또는 도지사를 경유하여 질병관리청장에게 이를 보고하여야 한다. <신설 2008. 9. 5., 2010. 3. 19., 2020. 9. 11.>
rows.text_en: ④ The head of a public health center who receives a report pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall report it to the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, Mayor, County Head, or District Head in accordance with Form No. 5-2 of the Attached Form; the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province who receives the report shall report it to the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency, and the Mayor, County Head, or District Head shall report it to the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency via the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, or Provincial Governor. <Newly added Sep. 5, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Sep. 11, 2020>
[Title amended Sep. 5, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(혈액ㆍ장기ㆍ조직등의 검사) ①법 제9조의 규정에 의하여 혈액원은 채혈된 모든 혈액에 대하여, 의사 또는 의료기관은 장기ㆍ조직 및 정액 기타 매개체에 대하여 각각 후천성면역결핍증 감염여부를 검사하고 감염이 의심되는 혈액ㆍ장기ㆍ조직ㆍ정액 및 매개체에 대하여는 확인검사기관의 장에게 검사를 의뢰하여 확인검사를 받아야 한다. <개정 2003. 12. 27., 2005. 9. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Examination of Blood, Organs, Tissues, etc.) ① Pursuant to the provisions of Article 9 of the Act, blood banks shall examine all collected blood for the presence of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS), and physicians or medical institutions shall examine organs, tissues, semen, and other carriers for the same purpose. For blood, organs, tissues, semen, and carriers suspected of infection, they shall request the head of a confirmatory testing institution to conduct a confirmatory examination. <Amended Dec. 27, 2003; Sep. 28, 2005>

rows.source_ko: ②수입혈액제제 또는 원료혈액제제를 수입하는 자가 법 제9조제1항 단서의 규정에 해당하는 서류를 첨부하지 아니하고 당해제품을 수입한 때에는 통관 이전에 식품의약품안전처장의 검사를 받아야 한다. <개정 2003. 12. 27., 2005. 9. 28., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② If a person importing imported blood products or raw blood products imports the said products without attaching the documents falling under the provisions of the proviso to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they shall undergo an inspection by the Minister of Food and Drug Safety prior to customs clearance. <Amended Dec. 27, 2003; Sep. 28, 2005; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(확인검사) 확인검사기관의 장은 제7조제2항 및 제8조제1항의 규정에 의하여 검사기관 또는 의료기관등으로부터 후천성면역결핍증 감염여부의 확인검사를 의뢰받은 때에는 지체없이 검사를 실시하고 검사결과를 의뢰기관에 통지하며, 감염 사실을 발견한 때에는 즉시 질병관리청장에게 보고하여야 한다. <개정 1999. 8. 10., 2003. 12. 27., 2005. 9. 28., 2008. 3. 3., 2010. 3. 19., 2020. 9. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Confirmatory Test) When the head of a confirmatory testing institution receives a request for a confirmatory test for the presence of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS) from a testing institution or medical institution, etc., pursuant to the provisions of Article 7, Paragraph 2 and Article 8, Paragraph 1, he/she shall conduct the test without delay and notify the requesting institution of the test results; and if the fact of infection is discovered, he/she shall report it immediately to the Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency. <Amended Aug. 10, 1999; Dec. 27, 2003; Sep. 28, 2005; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 19, 2010; Sep. 11, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(후천성면역결핍증예방관리자증명서) 법 제11조의 규정에 의한 증표는 별지 제6호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Certificate of Prevention and Management of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome) The identification card pursuant to the provisions of Article 11 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제11조(증명서 발급) ① 법 제8조에 따라 검진대상자가 검진을 받을 경우, 검진을 실시한 검사기관의 장은 본인의 요구가 있을 경우 별지 제7호서식의 후천성면역결핍증 검사확인서를 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Issuance of Certificate) ① Where a person subject to examination undergoes an examination pursuant to Article 8 of the Act, the head of the testing institution that conducted the examination shall issue a Confirmation of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome Test in the form of Annex 7 upon the request of the person concerned. <Amended Sep. 5, 2008>

rows.source_ko: ②외국에 여행하고자 하는 자가 국제간에 검진 사실의 확인을 받고자 하는 경우에는 검진을 실시한 검사기관의 장은 별지 제7호서식의 후천성면역결핍증 검사확인서를 발급한다. <개정 1999. 8. 10., 2008. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: ② In cases where a person intending to travel abroad wishes to obtain confirmation of the fact of an international medical examination, the head of the testing institution that conducted the examination shall issue a Confirmation of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome Test in the form of Annex 7. <Amended Aug. 10, 1999; Sep. 5, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제11조의2(요양시설 등의 시설 및 인력 등의 기준) 법 제16조제2항에 따른 감염인의 요양 및 치료 등을 위한 시설과 감염인에 대한 정보제공, 상담 및 자활을 위한 시설이 갖추어야 할 시설 및 인력 등의 기준은 별표와 같다. <개정 2008. 9. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 11-2 (Standards for Facilities and Personnel, etc. of Nursing Facilities, etc.) The standards for facilities and personnel, etc., to be met by facilities for the nursing and treatment, etc., of persons with infectious diseases pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Act, and facilities for the provision of information, counseling, and self-reliance of persons with infectious diseases, are as set forth in the Attached Table. <Amended Sep. 5, 2008>

Article 13 Deleted <Aug. 10, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제1조 (시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만,ㆍㆍㆍ<생략>ㆍㆍㆍ부칙 제4조의 규정의 시행일은 질병관리본부의 설치근거를 규정한 검역법중개정법률이 시행되는 날로 한다. [2004. 1. 17. 법률 제 7063호 검역법중개정법률의 시행일 2004. 1. 17.]
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, ...<Omitted> ...the enforcement date of the provisions of Article 4 of the Addenda shall be the date on which the Act Amending the Quarantine Act, which stipulates the legal basis for the establishment of the Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, enters into force. [Enforcement date of Act No. 7063, Act Amending the Quarantine Act, January 17, 2004]
Articles 2 and 3  omitted
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① to ⑧ Omitted

rows.source_ko: 제7조제2항, 제8조제1항ㆍ제2항 및 제9조중 “국립보건원장”을 각각 “질병관리본부장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 7, Paragraph 2, Article 8, Paragraphs 1 and 2, and Article 9, “Director of the National Institute of Health” shall be changed to “Director of the Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention”.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2  omitted

rows.text_en: 19. Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on Prevention of Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조제2항 각 호 외의 부분, 제7조제2항제3호, 같은 조 제4항, 제9조, 별지 제1호의2서식 신고방법에 관한 안내란 및 별지 제6호서식 앞쪽 중 “보건복지부장관”을 각각 “질병관리청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2, Paragraph 2, Article 7, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3, Paragraph 4 of the same article, Article 9, the guidance section on the reporting method of Form No. 1-2, and the front of Form No. 6, “Minister of Health and Welfare” shall be changed to “Commissioner of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency”.
In Article 7, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1, “Director of the Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention” shall be changed to “Director of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency.”

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식, 별지 제1호의2서식 및 별지 제5호의2서식 중 “질병관리본부(국립보건연구원)”를 각각 “질병관리청(국립보건연구원)”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Form No. 1, Form No. 1-2, and Form No. 5-2, “Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (National Institute of Health)” shall be changed to “Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (National Institute of Health)”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제2호서식 및 별지 제3호서식 중 “질병관리본부장”을 각각 “질병관리청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Forms No. 2 and No. 3, “Director of the Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention” shall be changed to “Director of the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency”.
20 Omitted
